screens.penny: Hi, {name}! Where should we keep our savings?

screens.title: A safe place

cards.caption: A jar or piggy bank keeps coins in one place.
A bank keeps money safe until you need it.

screens.penny: Both keep your money in one safe place, {name}.

screens.prompt: Which is a safer place to keep your savings?
screens.pennyHint: Where can you find it again later, {name}?
screens.rightMessage: Yes, {name}! In a jar you know exactly where it is.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! Coins in a pocket can slip out. A jar keeps them together.
screens.retryIntro: Let's think about safe places again, {name}.

screens.story: Leo gets 5 coins for his birthday. He is saving for a soccer ball.
screens.prompt: Where should Leo put his coins?

options.label: In his savings jar
options.outcome: Leo drops them in the jar. Next month they are all still there, waiting.

options.label: Loose on his desk
options.outcome: Some coins roll off the desk. Leo can't find them all when he goes to count.

screens.rightMessage: That's it, {name}! One safe place means nothing goes missing.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! Loose coins are easy to lose. A jar keeps them together.

screens.prompt: What does a bank do with your money?
screens.rightMessage: Yes, {name}! A bank keeps it safe until you need it.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! Your money stays yours. The bank just keeps it safe.
screens.retryIntro: Let's think about the bank again, {name}.

screens.title: Nice work, {name}!
screens.message: One safe place keeps your savings together.
